title: Identification Design
abstract: arXiv:2511.18647v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper introduces a model of identification design in which the decision maker observes the population distribution of signals generated by an information structure and ranks actions by their worst-case payoff over the admissible state distributions consistent with those signals. The environment is manipulable if every action is implementable under every admissible distribution of the state variable, and strongly so if this is achievable via almost fully informative information structures that conceal at most one dimension of information from the decision maker. We show that manipulability holds if and only if every action has the same worst-case payoff if and only if strong manipulability holds. In our main application to robust causal inference in econometrics, we verify that treatment-effects models satisfy both manipulability criteria. translated_abstract: 本文提出了一个“识别设计”模型，其中决策者观察由信息结构生成的信号总体分布，并根据与这些信号相一致的所有容许状态分布下的最坏情形收益对行动进行排序。如果每一个行动都可以在每一个容许的状态分布下得以实施，则该环境是“可操纵的”；如果这一结果可以通过几乎完全信息的信息结构（即至多向决策者隐藏一个维度的信息）来实现，则该环境是“强可操纵的”。我们证明：可操纵性成立当且仅当每个行动具有相同的最坏情形收益，当且仅当强可操纵性成立。在我们关于计量经济学中稳健因果推断的主要应用中，我们验证了处理效应模型同时满足这两种可操纵性标准。更广泛地，我们为可实施行动集合提供了完整的刻画。
tldr: 本文提出“识别设计”模型，证明环境可操纵性、强可操纵性与所有行动具有相同最坏情形收益三者等价，并将其应用于计量经济学稳健因果推断，验证了处理效应模型满足可操纵性标准。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an identification design model and proves that manipulability, strong manipulability, and equal worst-case payoffs across all actions are equivalent, applying this framework to verify that treatment-effects models in robust causal inference are manipulable.
